title: Rubber duck with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="72" rx="30" ry="20" fill="#FFD21E"/>
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="76" rx="26" ry="15" fill="#FFE24D"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M78 66 Q92 58 86 72 Q82 74 78 72 Z" fill="#F5C000"/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d="M32 58 Q30 44 40 40 L54 40 Q60 50 58 62 Z" fill="#FFD21E"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="38" r="18" fill="#FFD21E"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="36" r="14" fill="#FFE24D"/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d="M24 40 Q14 40 16 46 Q20 50 30 46 Z" fill="#FF7A00"/>
  <path d="M24 44 Q17 45 19 48 Q24 49 29 46 Z" fill="#FFA43D"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="32" r="3.2" fill="#4A2A00"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="32" r="3.2" fill="#4A2A00"/>
  <circle cx="39" cy="31" r="1.1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="31" r="1.1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- smiling face: cheeks -->
  <circle cx="33" cy="40" r="3" fill="#FF9EC0"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="40" r="3" fill="#FF9EC0"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M35 42 Q42 49 50 42" stroke="#C25A00" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- wing -->
  <path d="M56 60 Q70 62 68 74 Q60 76 54 70 Z" fill="#F5C000"/>
  <!-- water ripple -->
  <path d="M14 86 Q28 82 42 86 Q56 90 70 86 Q84 82 92 86" stroke="#7FD4FF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
